designs.Mara: a woman in her early thirties, exhausted, dark brown hair tied back loosely, a grey oversized cardigan over dark pyjamas, no jewellery; Caucasian, early 30s, pale olive skin. Slim, with a slightly oval face, a strong nose. Dark brown hair worn in a low, loose ponytail. The cardigan's sleeves are slightly too long; her pyjama bottoms are deep charcoal. Always has faint, natural dark circles under her eyes. Never wears jewellery or glasses.
designs.Lily: Exactly 4 years old, a small child, never older: toddler-like proportions with a large head for the body, round full cheeks, a small button nose, short arms and legs, small chubby hands, as tall as a kitchen table. a four-year-old girl with messy fair hair, pale yellow pyjamas with small stars; Caucasian, age 4, pale, freckled skin. Small, slight build. Round face with sharp blue eyes. Hair is shoulder-length, fine, and a light ash-blonde, worn messily loose. The pyjamas' stars are white on a muted, pale butter-yellow fabric. Never wears accessories; her socks are grey.
designs.The Storyteller: a tall, gaunt man of indeterminate age in a long, worn charcoal greatcoat and a shapeless old black felt hat with a wide, drooping brim (never a cowboy hat), his face always mostly in shadow under the brim except for pale, kind, tired eyes; he always carries an old iron lantern whose flame burns blood red

places.name: Lily's Bedroom
places.design: A small, sparsely decorated child's bedroom in a modest, older house. Walls are painted a tired light blue, now greyed in the shadows. A single shelf holds a star-shaped night-light (emits a cool, dim white) and some toys. The star-patterned duvet covers a simple wooden bed. A small wooden bedside table sits to the right of the bed. A sodium-vapor streetlight casts an occasional, faint amber-orange glow through the thin curtains at the single window.

places.name: Mara's Bedroom
places.design: An adult bedroom, austere and dark. Furniture is minimal: a dark wood-framed double bed and a matching, simple bedside table. The walls are a muted, cold grey. At night, the only illumination comes from the small red lights of electronic devices—primarily the baby monitor receiver—and minimal faint ambient light from a window facing another part of the house on a moonless night.

places.name: Upstairs Landing
places.design: A narrow, second-floor hallway with worn beige carpet and plain off-white walls showing hairline cracks. An aging, bare single-bulb ceiling fixture hangs at its center, its failing bulb flickering a weak, sickly yellow-white light. Doors to the bedrooms line one side, all painted the same faded white. The air is stagnant.
